pages.title: Varkala Cliff on UNESCO Tentative List

facts.text: Added: September 2025 to UNESCO tentative World Heritage list (⚠ not full status)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Place: Varkala, Kerala, on Arabian Sea — Mio-Pliocene laterite and sandstone cliffs; ⚠ only place in Kerala where laterite cliffs rise directly from the sea
facts.head: News

facts.text: Sacred sites: Janardana Swamy temple (2,000+ years; Karkidaka Vavu ritual), Sree Narayana Guru's Sivagiri Mutt
facts.head: News

facts.text: Threats: erosion, tourism, floods (2018–2019)
facts.head: News

pages.title: Saltwater crocodile survey — Sundarban Biosphere Reserve

facts.text: Survey: rise in saltwater crocodile numbers, better juvenile survival, diverse age structure in Sundarbans
facts.head: News

facts.text: Programme credited: captive breeding and release — Bhagabatpur Crocodile Project
facts.head: News

facts.text: Role: apex predator, hypercarnivore; indicator of mangrove health; tolerates wide salinity
facts.head: News

facts.text: Law: Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972 — ⚠ criticised as reactive, not proactive
facts.head: News

facts.text: World Environment Day 2025 (5 June) theme: "Ending Plastic Pollution"
facts.head: Data

facts.text: OECD Global Plastic Outlook: production doubled 2000–2019 to 460 million t; waste 353 million t
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Waste fate: recycled 9%, incinerated 19%, landfilled 50%, mismanaged 22%
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Waste by source: packaging 40%, consumer goods 12%, textiles 11%
facts.head: Data

facts.text: 2024: ~500 million t produced, 400 million t waste; 2060 → 1.2 billion t
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Ocean: 11 million t a year enter oceans (Ocean Conservancy); ~200 million t already there
facts.head: Data

facts.text: GHG: plastics 3.4% of emissions; could be 19% of carbon budget by 2040 (UNEP)
facts.head: Data

facts.text: Health letter: 18 million health professionals, 88 countries
facts.head: Data

facts.text: UNEA-5 (2022): all 193 members agreed to negotiate a legally binding plastics treaty — ⚠ not a ban on production
facts.head: Global response

facts.text: UNEP aim: cut plastic waste 80% in two decades
facts.head: Global response

facts.text: EPR: Extended Producer Responsibility
facts.head: Global response

facts.text: Place: Minicoy island, Lakshadweep — fire in ~4,000 tonnes of dry waste
facts.head: News

facts.text: Harm: Porites corals bleaching; leachate; fisheries
facts.head: News

facts.text: Governance: elected panchayats replaced by appointed officials; NGT monitoring (⚠ did not halt tourism)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Laws: CRZ norm violations
facts.head: News

pages.title: Emissions may cut surface solar radiation over India by up to 10%

facts.text: Study: Ashwin Jadhav and Rohini Bhawar, Savitribai Phule Pune University — journal Energy and Climate Change
facts.head: News

facts.text: Finding: up to 10% fall in surface solar radiation (SSR) over central, southern, eastern India under intermediate/high emissions — due to aerosols, turbidity, post-monsoon clouds
facts.head: News

facts.text: Mean SSR loss: ~1.10 W/m² per decade (intermediate), ~1.32 W/m² per decade (high)
facts.head: News

facts.text: ⚠ Indo-Gangetic Plains and NE may see marginal increase (low emission); north-west India most stable
facts.head: News

facts.text: India solar capacity: 123,130.13 MW (31 Aug 2025); renewables 37% of capacity but ~18% of generation
facts.head: News

facts.text: Announced by: Nitin Gadkari — ARAI (Automotive Research Association of India) studying isobutanol–diesel blending; pilot ~18 months
facts.head: News

facts.text: Why not ethanol: low flash point, volatility, poor miscibility with diesel
facts.head: News

facts.text: Isobutanol: ⚠ higher flash point, better miscibility; ⚠ lower cetane number (needs additives); up to 10% blending safe
facts.head: News

facts.text: Feedstock: sugarcane syrup, B-heavy molasses, grains; a 150 klpd plant → ~125 klpd ethanol + 20 klpd isobutanol
facts.head: News

facts.text: Environment Audit Rules, 2025 notified to strengthen environmental compliance (headline only in source)
facts.head: News

pages.title: Offshore freshwater aquifer off US north-east coast

facts.text: Finding: vast offshore freshwater aquifer beneath Atlantic Ocean from New Jersey to Maine
facts.head: News

facts.text: Drilling: ~1,289 feet below sea floor; ~50,000 litres extracted; cost ~$25 million
facts.head: News

facts.text: Could supply: New York City for 800 years
facts.head: News

facts.text: Scientist quoted: Brandon Dugan, Colorado School of Mines
facts.head: News

facts.text: Offshore aquifers: extend up to 90 km offshore; ~1 million km³ freshwater (~10% of terrestrial freshwater) — 2021 study in Environmental Research Letters
facts.head: Background

facts.text: Origin theories: Ice Age recharge; connection to onshore aquifers; held by clay cap rock
facts.head: Background

facts.text: ⚠ Not recharged by current rainfall directly
facts.head: Background

facts.text: UN 2023: freshwater demand to exceed supply by 40% by 2030
facts.head: Background

pages.title: New paradigm of urbanism in the Himalayas

facts.text: Population: Himalayas home to 210 million+ across 7 countries; 50 million+ in India
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Disasters cited: flash flood at Dharali (Uttarkashi), landslides in Mandi, floods in J&K
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Problem: towns follow generic plains building codes in a highly seismic zone; construction over springs
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Jobs: cities to generate over 70% of new jobs in next 5 years
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Urban population: near 1 billion by 2050
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Housing: 144 million new homes needed by 2070; more than half of 2070 housing stock yet to be built
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Flood losses: $5 billion by 2030 → $30 billion by 2070; over 25% urban roads exposed to flooding
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Urban Heat Island: night temperatures 3–5°C higher
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Investment needed: ~$10.95 trillion over 30 years
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Examples: Kolkata flood forecasting; Chennai stormwater; Ahmedabad Heat Action Plan
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Worsens winter air pollution in Delhi-NCR; alternatives — Happy Seeder, biomass industry, crop diversification
facts.head: Points

facts.text: Supreme Court has mandated action; CPCB monitors
facts.head: Points

facts.text: NITI Aayog: ~600 million Indians face high–extreme water stress; ~2 lakh deaths a year from unsafe water
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: NFHS-5: in ~71% rural households women (15+) fetch water; ~173 km and 210 hours a year
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: 'Water wives': polygamy for water collection in drought-hit Maharashtra
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: FAO: female-headed households lose 3% more income to floods (~$35/person/yr)
facts.head: Facts

facts.text: Suggestion: VWSCs with ≥50% women; JJM, AMRUT 2.0
facts.head: Facts
